chapterInfo.content:
13
Israelfoɔ kɔfa Apam Adaka no firi Kiriat-yearim
(2 Samuel 6.1-11)
1 # 2 Sa 6.1-11 Na Dawid ne apem apem ne ɔha ha so asafohene ne mmapɔmma no nyinaa kɔɔ agyina, 2na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Israel badwa no nyinaa sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ wɔ mo ani so na ɛfiri AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a, momma yɛmmu mu nsoma mma wɔnkɔ yɛn nuanom a wɔaka Israel nsase nyinaa soɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ a wɔka wɔn ho wɔn tenabea nkuro mu no nkyɛn, na wɔmmoaboa wɔn ano mmra yɛn nkyɛn, 3na yɛmfa yɛn Nyankopɔn adaka no ntwam mmra yɛn nkyɛn. Na Saulo berɛ so no, yɛammisa akyire kwan. 4Ɛnna badwa no nyinaa kaa sɛ wɔnyɛ saa, ɛfiri sɛ na asɛm no tene ɔman no nyinaa ani so.
5Na Dawid boaa Israel man no nyinaa ano hyiae de firii Sihor a ɛwɔ Misraim kɔsii deɛ ɛde rekɔ Hamat, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Nyankopɔn adaka no afiri Kiriat-yearim aba. 6#Yos 15.9 Na Dawid ne Israel nyinaa foro kɔɔ Baala a ɛne Kiriat-yearim a ɛwɔ Yuda no, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Onyankopɔn, AWURADE a ɔte kerubim soɔ a wɔbɔ ne din frɛ no no, adaka no afiri hɔ aba. 7Na wɔyii Nyankopɔn adaka no sii teaseɛnam foforɔ bi so firii Abinadab fie. Na Usa ne Ahio piaa teaseɛnam no. 8Na Dawid ne Israel nyinaa goroe, Nyankopɔn anim, wɔde ahoɔden nyinaa ne nnwom ne asankuo ne mmɛnta ne mpintin ne nnawuro ne ntotorobɛnto.
9Na wɔduruu Kidon ayuporebea no, Usa tenee ne nsa kɔsɔɔ adaka no mu, ɛfiri sɛ anantwie no hinhimii. 10Na AWURADE bo fuu Usa, na ɔkumm no, sɛ ɔtenee ne nsa kaa adaka no nti, na ɔwuu Nyankopɔn anim hɔ. 11Na Dawid ampɛ sɛ AWURADE abufuo aba Usa soɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ sɛ Peres-usa de bɛsi nnɛ. 12Na Dawid suroo Nyankopɔn da no, na ɔkaa sɛ: Mede Nyankopɔn adaka no bɛba me nkyɛn sɛn? 13Na Dawid amfa adaka no amma ne nkyɛn Dawid kuro no mu, na ɔde mane kɔɔ Gitini Obed-Edom fie. 14Na Nyankopɔn adaka no sii Obed-Edom fie bosome mmiɛnsa, na AWURADE hyiraa Obed-Edom fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa.

Na Dawid ne apem apem ne ɔha ha so asafohene ne mmapɔmma no nyinaa kɔɔ agyina, na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Israel badwa no nyinaa sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ wɔ mo ani so na ɛfiri AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a, momma yɛmmu mu nsoma mma wɔnkɔ yɛn nuanom a wɔaka Israel nsase nyinaa soɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ a wɔka wɔn ho wɔn tenabea nkuro mu no nkyɛn, na wɔmmoaboa wɔn ano mmra yɛn nkyɛn, na yɛmfa yɛn Nyankopɔn adaka no ntwam mmra yɛn nkyɛn. Na Saulo berɛ so no, yɛammisa akyire kwan. Ɛnna badwa no nyinaa kaa sɛ wɔnyɛ saa, ɛfiri sɛ na asɛm no tene ɔman no nyinaa ani so.
Na Dawid boaa Israel man no nyinaa ano hyiae de firii Sihor a ɛwɔ Misraim kɔsii deɛ ɛde rekɔ Hamat, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Nyankopɔn adaka no afiri Kiriat-yearim aba. Na Dawid ne Israel nyinaa foro kɔɔ Baala a ɛne Kiriat-yearim a ɛwɔ Yuda no, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Onyankopɔn, AWURADE a ɔte kerubim soɔ a wɔbɔ ne din frɛ no no, adaka no afiri hɔ aba. Na wɔyii Nyankopɔn adaka no sii teaseɛnam foforɔ bi so firii Abinadab fie. Na Usa ne Ahio piaa teaseɛnam no. Na Dawid ne Israel nyinaa goroe, Nyankopɔn anim, wɔde ahoɔden nyinaa ne nnwom ne asankuo ne mmɛnta ne mpintin ne nnawuro ne ntotorobɛnto.
Na wɔduruu Kidon ayuporebea no, Usa tenee ne nsa kɔsɔɔ adaka no mu, ɛfiri sɛ anantwie no hinhimii. Na AWURADE bo fuu Usa, na ɔkumm no, sɛ ɔtenee ne nsa kaa adaka no nti, na ɔwuu Nyankopɔn anim hɔ. Na Dawid ampɛ sɛ AWURADE abufuo aba Usa soɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ sɛ Peres-usa de bɛsi nnɛ. Na Dawid suroo Nyankopɔn da no, na ɔkaa sɛ: Mede Nyankopɔn adaka no bɛba me nkyɛn sɛn? Na Dawid amfa adaka no amma ne nkyɛn Dawid kuro no mu, na ɔde mane kɔɔ Gitini Obed-Edom fie. Na Nyankopɔn adaka no sii Obed-Edom fie bosome mmiɛnsa, na AWURADE hyiraa Obed-Edom fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
